briefing: Stocks jumped today, with the NASDAQ up 6.7% and the S&P 500 up 4.8%. Moves this large in one day are rare, so the data may cover more than one session. Following our rule of using spare cash on strong up days, we are putting the available $645 into NVDA, the only candidate with every confirmation signal including above-average trading volume. All seven existing positions stay open, and their automatic stop-loss and profit-target sells remain in place.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier, faster-growing assets such as tech and chip stocks, instead of safe havens like bonds or cash. You can often spot it when the tech-heavy NASDAQ rises more than the broader S&P 500, as it did today. For an active investor, a risk-on day is often a good time to put spare cash to work in the strongest candidates.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）是指投資者信心充足，資金從債券或現金等避險資產，轉投科技股及晶片股等風險較高、增長較快的資產。常見的跡象是以科技股為主的納斯達克指數升幅跑贏整體標普500指數，正如今日的情況。對主動型投資者而言，這類日子往往是將閒置現金投入最強勢標的的好時機。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose sharply and broadly today: the NASDAQ gained 6.7% and the S&P 500 gained 4.8%, with semiconductor and AI hardware names such as NVDA, MU, DELL and MRVL leading. No news headlines were provided with today's data, so we can't name the specific cause, and a one-day move this big may reflect more than one trading session. Technology stocks rising more than the wider market suggests investors were willing to take on more risk and moved money back into higher-growth AI and chip stocks.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面急升，納斯達克指數大漲6.7%，標普500指數升4.8%，半導體及AI硬件股如NVDA、MU、DELL及MRVL領漲。今日數據未附新聞標題，因此無法確定觸發升勢的具體消息；單日升幅如此巨大，亦可能涵蓋多於一個交易日的走勢。科技股升幅明顯跑贏大市，反映投資者風險胃納回升，資金重新流入高增長的AI及晶片板塊。

trades.reasoning: NVDA is the only candidate showing all four confirmation signals at once: a MACD crossover, RSI at 62.2 (bullish but below overbought), price well above its 20-day average, and a volume surge, which together point to institutional buying.
